foundation: operation.Context.Derive from secure operation.Factory seed; no foundation algorithm changes

recovered_constraints.gate: Owned selected-dialog-enabled married Hero; all six at cap rejects without charge

chosen_math.interpretation: Explicit reconstruction: init_rate[1] negative weight, [2] positive weight; rate_change_step is percentage-point progress bucket width; progress_rate_change is added negative probability in percentage points per bucket. Source exposes parameters but does not establish these meanings.
chosen_math.negative_probability_bp: If progress_bp<1000:0. Else steps=floor((progress_bp-1000)/(rate_change_step*100)); negative_bp=min(9900,init_rate[1]*100 + steps*(progress_rate_change*100)). Tables sum weights100; reject unsupported shapes.
chosen_math.direction: Unbiased integer draw in[0,9999]; negative if draw<negative_bp, positive otherwise. Axis/cost/direction labels domain separated.
chosen_math.amount: Independent unbiased integer in chosen inclusive source span. Clamp proposed applied value to[0,sourcecap]; feed_add is proposed-current, not unclamped raw amount.
chosen_math.sampling: Use Context.Derive stable named labels and draw ordinal; unsigned32-bit rejection sampling over2^32 avoids modulo bias. Rejection round appears in label, never SQL retry count.
chosen_math.correlation: Independent per-axis direction/amount draws; no invented whole-vector success guarantee or paid reroll until favorable.

lifecycle: Persist exact pending outcome, applied base, candidate revision, policy/content binding and generation receipt atomically with I5 charge; SAVE alone applies. Known semantic replay returns stored result without RNG.
update_policy: Future formula change requires a new family policy version; pending candidates retain their pinned results/rules. No global RNG service/new entropy table required.
